selection: Fixed first1000 SHA-ordered unique Enron raw cases perlabel, deduplicated before any prediction against all previously observed and within-cohort raw/body-feature fingerprints. Membership was frozen before final model fitting; explicit IDs reproduce without prior-study data.
hardHamSubset: not supplied by corpus; prior hard-ham regression separately required

generalProvenance.supportedRepresentation: NFKC normalized ASCII letters, no other letters or marks

policy.scope: actual production MIME parser, intake/assessment, serialized scorer RPC adapter and routing policy; no mailbox mutation

release.scope: Five previously observed corpora are regression only, not independent acceptance

limits: Enron-Spam raw source archives are dated research mail, not modern provider traffic. Balanced fixed sample; no separately labeled hard-ham subset.
Enron-Spam was published in 2006 and is not representative of a current mailbox.
Inspection completeness and classification uncertainty are separate. Retained mail is not classified safe.
Unavailable spam remains a routing miss; unavailable counts are also reported separately.
No training, threshold tuning, mail sending, DNS/auth replay or production accuracy claim.
